eyebrow.zh: 计划对照 · 结构化差异

headline.zh:
计划承诺了什么，
记录里做了什么。
headline.en:
The plan made a promise.
Inspect what the trace says.

sub.zh: DriftLedger 对照 Markdown 计划与 JSONL 执行记录，列出匹配、偏离、未执行和额外步骤，并保存人工接受与计划修订的记录。
sub.en: DriftLedger compares Markdown plans with JSONL execution traces, identifies matched, drifting, unexecuted and extra steps, and records human acceptance and plan revisions.

caption.zh: 让计划与执行记录放在一起检查
caption.en: Review the plan beside the execution trace.

body.zh: 未执行和额外工作不会被混成一个总分。
body.en: Unexecuted and extra work remain distinct rather than becoming one score.

body.zh: 人工接受与后续计划修订进入可读取的 JSONL ledger。
body.en: Human acceptance and later revisions appear in a readable JSONL ledger.

body.zh: diff 支持 JSON 和显式的 fail-on-drift 退出行为。
body.en: diff supports JSON and explicit fail-on-drift exit behavior.

title.zh: 让计划与执行记录放在一起检查
title.en: Review the plan beside the execution trace.

body.zh: 计划和实际执行常保存在不同地方，检查时容易只看到最终产物。把步骤 ID 与验收关键词一起对照，可以先发现哪些承诺没有在记录中出现，再由作者判断偏离是否合理。匹配来自结构规则，不是对完成质量的模型评判。
body.en: Plans and actual execution often live in separate places, leaving review focused on the final artifact. Comparing step IDs and acceptance keywords helps identify promises absent from the trace before a human decides whether the deviation is justified. Matching is structural, not a model judgment of completion quality.

body.zh: 仓库提供三步计划、三条固定时间的构造 trace 和空 ledger。JSON 返回四行：parse 为 matched；report 缺少 report json 标准，为 drifting；verify 为 unexecuted；extra 为计划外动作。命令不修改计划或 Git 历史。
body.en: The repository supplies a three-step plan, three constructed events with fixed timestamps, and an empty ledger. JSON returns four rows: parse is matched, report is drifting because report json is unmet, verify is unexecuted, and extra is outside the plan. The command changes neither the plan nor Git history.

body.zh: plan 解析版本、步骤和 accept 行，trace 读取带时间戳的事件。Reconcile 按步骤归组并比较摘要关键词，ledger 再叠加人工接受状态。diff 输出文本或 JSON；watch 用 TUI 展示并接受偏离；patch 改写计划版本；rollback 只输出待人工处理的 Git 指令。
body.en: plan parses the version, steps and accept lines; trace reads timestamped events. Reconcile groups by step and compares summary keywords, then ledger overlays human acceptance. diff emits text or JSON, watch provides the review TUI, patch rewrites the plan version, and rollback emits Git instructions for manual handling.

body.zh: DriftLedger 对照 Markdown 计划与 JSONL 执行记录，列出匹配、偏离、未执行和额外步骤，并保存人工接受与计划修订的记录。
body.en: DriftLedger compares Markdown plans with JSONL execution traces, identifies matched, drifting, unexecuted and extra steps, and records human acceptance and plan revisions.

body.zh: 对照依赖 trace 自报摘要和关键词，不证明动作真实发生或任务正确完成。
body.en: Reconciliation relies on reported summaries and keywords; it does not prove actions occurred or tasks completed correctly.

note.zh: v0.8.0 的实际结构对照输出。输入是构造记录，不是一次真实 Agent 执行或实际工具动作的证明。
note.en: Actual structural comparison output from v0.8.0. Inputs are constructed records, not a real agent run or proof of actual tool actions.

body.zh: 仓库提供三步计划、三条固定时间的构造 trace 和空 ledger。JSON 返回四行：parse 为 matched；report 缺少 report json 标准，为 drifting；verify 为 unexecuted；extra 为计划外动作。命令不修改计划或 Git 历史。
body.en: The repository supplies a three-step plan, three constructed events with fixed timestamps, and an empty ledger. JSON returns four rows: parse is matched, report is drifting because report json is unmet, verify is unexecuted, and extra is outside the plan. The command changes neither the plan nor Git history.

steps.command: go run ./cmd/driftledger diff examples/presentation-plan.md examples/presentation-trace.jsonl --ledger examples/presentation-empty-ledger.jsonl --json --json-pretty

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。首次构建可能下载依赖；对照过程不调用模型或网络服务。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. Initial builds may download dependencies; reconciliation calls no model or network service.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/driftledger.git
cd driftledger
go build -o driftledger ./cmd/driftledger

limitations.zh: 对照依赖 trace 自报摘要和关键词，不证明动作真实发生或任务正确完成。
limitations.en: Reconciliation relies on reported summaries and keywords; it does not prove actions occurred or tasks completed correctly.

limitations.zh: rollback 输出指令但不执行，用户仍需选择正确提交并处理回滚。
limitations.en: rollback emits instructions without executing them; the user must choose the correct commit and handle reversal.
